RedirectRequest.title: CreateSessionRequest
RedirectRequest.description: Information required to create a session.

type.description:
Parameter used for additional session types.
Use `autopay` to generate an AutoPay session.

buyer.description:
Data of the **buyer** user, refers to the user who is purchasing a product or service.

**When creating a session**: Can be sent if you know the user making the purchase, as it helps complete the session information.
If this data is sent, the user will have their personal data pre-filled and can change it in Checkout.

payer.description:
Data of the **payer** user, refers to the owner of the payment method or user who paid the requested amount.

**When creating a session**: Should only be used when you want to "force" the data of the user who will complete the process.
If this data is sent, the user will have their personal data pre-filled but **cannot change it**.

fields.description: Structure to relate additional information in the process. See more in [Additional Fields](/en/checkout/additional-fields)

paymentMethod.description:
Used to restrict the payment methods available in checkout.
Multiple codes can be sent separated by commas.
See more at [Payment methods](/checkout/payment-methods)

Ex: `visa,master,pse`

cancelUrl.description:
Cancel URL, the user is redirected to this URL when they decide not to continue with the process.
Occurs when the user clicks on _I do not wish to continue_.

skipResult.description: If `true` is sent, when the user finishes the process the session result page will not be displayed, instead they will be redirected to the `returnUrl`. See more at [Skip result](/checkout/skip-result)

noBuyerFill.description: By default, the data sent as `buyer` is pre-filled in the Checkout interface to speed up the payment process, if this parameter is sent as `true` then this pre-filling will not be done.

ipAddress.description: IP address of the user who will perform the process.

userAgent.description: User Agent of the user's browser that will carry out the process.

returnUrl.description:
Return URL, to this url the user is redirected once the session ends.
Occurs when the user clicks on _Return to commerce_.

e.g.: `https://merchant.com/return`

locale.description: Language in which the request and the session will be processed. See more in [Location](/en/checkout/localization)

RedirectInformation.title: RedirectInformation
RedirectInformation.description: Response structure for a transaction information request.

request.description: Contains the information used to create/update the autopay session request.

reference.description:
Unique payment reference, consisting of up to 32 alphanumeric characters and permitted symbols 
e.g.: `PAYMENT_0001_ABC`, `Venta_1234-ABCD#2024/03/15$500`, `Ord: 1001/2023`

description.description:
Description of the process to be performed, allowing up to 250 alphanumeric, accented characters, and common symbols 
e.g.: `Cita con el Dr. Pérez a las 10:00 am. 5/12/2024, por $100.00`

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Information on the amount to be collected

currency.description:
Alphabetical code of the currency to be used [ISO 4217 alpha code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217)   
e.g.: `USD`

total.description:
Total value in the indicated base currency   
e.g.: `1000` equals _one thousand dollars_

taxes.description: Structure to define taxes in the payment process.

items.title: Taxes
items.description: Structure to define information about a tax.

base.description:
Base amount on which the tax is calculated   
e.g.: `1000`

details.description: Structure to define additional details of the amount in the payment process.

items.title: Details
items.description: Structure to store information about a detail.

allowPartial.description:
Defines if the amount to be charged can be paid in several transactions.
When set to `true` the user will be able to complete the payment in multiple transactions.

items.description: Possesses a collection of element structures.
items.title: Item

qty.description:
Number of articles of this type.   
e.g.: `23`

price.description:
Total cost of the article.   
e.g.: `1400`

additional.description: Object that allows sending additional data in JSON format.

items.description: Structure to relate products or items in the process.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.description: Structure to indicate the frequency of a recurring charge.

interval.description:
In combination with `periodicity`, indicates how often the charge will be made.
E.g.: For 15 days, use `interval: 15` `periodicity: "D"`.

maxPeriods.description: Maximum number of periods. Use `-1` if there is no limit

notificationUrl.description: URL where the service will notify each time a charge is made

subscribe.description:
When `true` is sent, a subscription payment session is generated.

In the payment process, the user can choose whether or not to save his payment method to be used in future charges..

dispersion.description:
When defined, a scatter payment session is generated.
The generated payment can be divided into different destinations according to the given conditions.

items.title: DispersionDetail
items.description: Structure that reflects the information of the details for payment with dispersion.

amount.description: I ride to "scatter" in this destination.

agreement.description:
Id of the destination of this amount. It can be the id of a site.

e.g.: `122`

agreementType.description:
Type of destination of this amount.
`MERCHANT` for sites, `AIRLINE` for airlines.

items.title: Modifiers
items.description:
Structure for additional modifications in the collection.

Applies to tax laws in specific countries.

type.description:
Modifier type identifier. 
Only `FEDERAL_GOVERNMENT` is currently supported.

code.description:
Modifier code.

 For `FEDERAL_GOVERMENT` represents the law number for discount.
`17934` Gastronomic Services
`18083` IMESI Brazil - Argentina
`19210` Financial Inclusion
`18910` Family Allowances
`18999` Real Estate Reimbursement

additional.description: Structure for appending information to the modifier

invoice.description:
Required when `modifiers.[].type` is `FEDERAL_GOVERMENT`. Indicates the invoice number.

e.g.: `123456789`

modifiers.description:
Structure to define modifiers in the collection.

Applies to tax laws in specific countries.

processorFields.description: Structure that may vary over time depending on the information available for the means of payment. See more in [Processor Fields](/en/checkout/processor-fields)

expiration.description:
Expiration date of a session. The user must finish the process before this date.
The expiration time must be at least 5 minutes from the time of creation. See more in [Expiration date](/en/checkout/expiration)   
e.g.: `2024-09-03T12:23:39-05:00`

buyer.description:
**Buyer** user data, refers to the user who is purchasing a product or a service.

**When creating a session:** It can be sent if you know the user who is making the subscription, as it helps to complete the session information.
If this data is provided, the user will have their personal information pre-filled and will be able to modify it in Checkout.

payer.description:
**Payer** user data, refers to the owner of the payment method or the user who has paid or will pay the requested amount.

**When creating a session:** It should only be used when you want to enforce the data of the user who will complete the process.
If this data is provided, the user will have their personal information pre-filled but **will not be able to modify it**.

subscription.title: SubscriptionRequest
subscription.description:
When sent, a subscription session is generated.

The user registers a payment method so that later the merchant can charge on that payment method.

paymentMethod.description:
Used to restrict the payment methods available in checkout.
Multiple codes can be sent separated by commas.
See more at [Payment methods](/checkout/payment-methods)

Ex: `visa,master,pse`

cancelUrl.description:
Cancel URL, the user is redirected to this URL when they decide not to continue with the process.
Occurs when the user clicks on _I do not wish to continue_.

skipResult.description: If `true` is sent, when the user finishes the process the session result page will not be displayed, instead they will be redirected to the `returnUrl`. See more at [Skip result](/checkout/skip-result)

noBuyerFill.description: By default, the data sent as `buyer` is pre-filled in the Checkout interface to speed up the payment process, if this parameter is sent as `true` then this pre-filling will not be done.

type.description: Parameter used for additional session types.

metadata.description: Key-value structure used to send additional information and determine specific behaviors during session processing.

initiatorIndicator.description: Indicates that the session will be processed by an agent using the cardholder's data

EBTDeliveryIndicator.description: (Required for EBT payments): Defines the delivery type

openingDate.description: Account creation date (format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Required for PSE in merchants with “Financial Services” category.

beneficiaryId.description: Beneficiary ID linked to the receiving account in a PSE transaction. Required for merchants in the “Financial Services” category

kount.description: Additional information about the transaction that can be used for risk analysis and fraud prevention.

provider.description: Name of the shipping or delivery provider.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number provided by the carrier.

accessUrl.description: URL for accessing shipping or download information.

digitalDownloaded.description: Indicates whether the digital product has been downloaded.

downloadDeviceIp.description: IP address of the device used for download.

store.description: Information about the physical store associated with the transaction.

region.description: Region or state of the store.

requiresConfirmation.description:
Indicates whether the transaction requires merchant confirmation before final processing.
When set to `true`, the transaction will be created in PENDING_CONFIRMATION state
and the merchant must call confirm or cancel via the transaction actions endpoint.

autopay.title: AutopayRequest
autopay.description: Detail of the autopay to be generated. The user must register a payment method so that automatic charges are made on that payment method according to the agreed conditions. Required when `.type` is `autopay`.

action.description:
Indicates the action to be performed with the autopay.
One of: `CREATE` to create an autopay, `EDIT` to edit an existing autopay.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description:
Unique reference of the process. Maximum of 32 characters

e.g.: `PAYMENT_0001_ABC`

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the process to be carried out
description.example: Consumption for the month of May

id.description: Required when `action` is `EDIT`. Identifier of the existing autopay.

dueDay.description:
For recurring payments with a monthly frequency, it corresponds to the payment cutoff day.
It is an informative value to indicate to the user the maximum expected day to make the payment.
It usually indicates that charges after this day may have surcharges or may not be available.    
E.g.: `15` for the fifteenth day of each month.

recurring.title: AutopayRecurring
recurring.description: Required when `action` is `CREATE`. Indicates the recurrence conditions of the autopay.

type.description:
Corresponds to the type of charge that the recurrence will have. Only used in self-pay sessions.
`FIXED`: The amount is fixed and was defined from the creation of the self-payment,
`MINIMUM_BALANCE`: The minimum amount to keep the recurrence active, defined by an external service,
`TOTAL_BALANCE`: The total defined in the asset, defined by an external service

amount.description: Required when `recurring.type` is `FIXED`. Defines the fixed amount to be charged in each recurrence.

oneOf.description: Structure containing information about the attempts to create or update an autopay within the same session.
